Account background: Harborwise builds an AI-first support workspace used by mid-market SaaS companies. Core product: agent UI + automated ticket routing and deflection. Looking to replace an ageing Elastic cluster + ad-hoc reranker with purpose-built embeddings + reranking pipeline.

Primary asks / constraints: 
- Index scale: ~5M granular docs (kb pages + 18 months of tickets + metadata); expect monthly +15% growth.
- Latency: tight SLO — customer insists on p95 end-to-end query latency <= 250ms for deflection flow (frontend → embed+search+rerank → first-token). Typical target: 150-200ms p50.
- Throughput: baseline expected 50–80 QPS during peak support hours; burst to 200 QPS for incident spikes.
- Cost sensitivity: want cost-per-query target ≤ $0.0025 (embeddings + search + rerank amortized).
- Quality metric: reranker must lift top-5 relevance; measuring MRR@5 and nDCG@5. Need deterministic fallback to cheaper model under heavy load.

Model & infra preferences: 
- Prefer open/Redwood-verified embeddings models but want ability to route to cheaper 8-bit quantized variants for bulk indexing.
- Reranker: expensive cross-encoder for top-5 re-ranking; candidate recall done via ANN + candidate generation.
- Strong interest in prefix/KV caching and workload-aware batching to meet cost/latency targets.

Security/compliance: 
- Must support SSO/SAML, KMS-managed keys, audit logs retained for 12 months, and EU data residency for EU customers. Air-gapped on-prem package is a plus for regulated verticals.
